subject: Animation
title: How The Simpsons Changed Everything
description: A short lesson to help you apply How The Simpsons Changed Everything.

hook.text: In 1989, The Simpsons debuted on Fox and shattered the assumption that cartoons were just for children.

buildup.text: Matt Groening created the family as crude sketches for The Tracey Ullman Show in 1987.

discovery.text: The Simpsons became the first animated show since The Flintstones to succeed in prime time.

twist.text: President George H.W. Bush publicly attacked the show, calling it a bad influence on American families.

climax.text: The controversy made the show even more popular. It became the longest-running American sitcom in history.

punchline.text: A yellow family that annoyed the president became TV's longest-running sitcom.

quiz.question: What distinction did The Simpsons achieve in American television history?
options: It was the first cartoon shown on Fox
It became the longest-running American sitcom, proving animation could sustain prime-time audiences
It was the first animated show to win an Emmy
